Container.Name: vpn-exit-bench-socket-proxy
Container.Overview: Restricted Docker API proxy for VPN Exit Bench. Intended only for the private user-defined Docker network named vpn-exit-bench. Port 2375 is intentionally NOT published to the Unraid host/LAN.

Config.Name: Docker Socket
Config.Description: Host Docker socket used only by this restricted proxy

Config.Name: CONTAINERS
Config.Description: Allow the container API section required to create/inspect/remove benchmark workers

Config.Name: POST
Config.Description: Allow mutating Docker API calls required to create and clean up benchmark workers

Config.Name: ALLOW_RESTARTS
Config.Description: Allows kill/stop paths needed for timed-out workers

Config.Name: EVENTS
Config.Description: VPN Exit Bench does not need Docker event streaming
